categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches fuzz harness machinery in `src/test/fuzz/http_request.cpp` with the Fuzzing label.
categories.rationale: Adds fuzz testing coverage for `GetQueryParameterFromUri()`, which parses unauthenticated client-supplied query strings for REST endpoints without prior fuzz harness coverage. While helpful to detect parser edge cases and crashes in untrusted input handling, it targets a low-traffic REST helper rather than high-risk core subsystems like consensus or P2P.
